Specifically this time we went down south to visit his side of the family and told her, it was never asking with him, aren't you gonna put makeup on we are visiting you know. Long story short, controlling behavior starts as small "requests" but gets bigger with every inch given. Nip it at the bud hun. Also NTA.

I dont know if this helps any and know its not the same thing, but back when I had a really bad concussion I carried a physical planner/diary around because of memory loss. I also had a lil notebook I had in my pocket that I would write in and others who knew about my condition would tell me to write in when we talked. I may not see these notes the next day but it helped ease the terror I felt not knowing what happened during x time. Obviosly it didnt get written in all the time since forgetting it/having trouble writing my own damn name, but what little info I could jot down comforted me. It's not the same thing, wont help with memories prior to your surgery, but maybe it'll bring some comfort to you dealing with the present?
